transport_question: does the v8 state change survive when the P<-Q conditional map is trained on a disjoint background environment rather than the native pooled training environment
source_environment_rule: leave-one-background-block-as-source; source block is excluded from the evaluation block and selected without occurrence outcomes
evaluation_environment_rule: evaluate on a different held-out block using the frozen v5 four-metric evidence contract

decision.transported: all evaluable source-target pairs reproduce the v8 non-contributory transition
decision.local_alignment_only: no evaluable source-target pair reproduces the transition
decision.heterogeneous: some but not all evaluable pairs reproduce the transition
